segments.source: Acknowledgements
segments.translation: 감사의 말

segments.source: Sponsoring
segments.translation: 후원

segments.source: The following people and organisations have contributed to make this effort possible:
segments.translation: 다음의 사람들과 단체가 이 노력을 가능하게 만드는 데 기여했습니다:

segments.source: [@fricklerhandwerk] serves as the team lead since 2023-02, sponsored by [Antithesis](https://antithesis.com) from 2023-02 to 2024-04
segments.translation: [@fricklerhandwerk]는 2023-02부터 팀 리더를 맡고 있으며, 2023-02부터 2024-04까지 [Antithesis](https://antithesis.com)의 후원을 받았습니다

segments.source: [@zmitchell] led the Learning Journey Working Group from 2023-03 to 2023-08, sponsored by [flox](https://floxdev.com)
segments.translation: [@zmitchell]는 2023-03부터 2023-08까지 학습 여정 워킹 그룹을 이끌었으며, [flox](https://floxdev.com)의 후원을 받았습니다.

segments.source: [@infinisil] worked on the team between 2022-11 and 2024-05, sponsored by [Tweag]
segments.translation: [@infinisil]는 2022-11부터 2024-05까지 팀에서 활동했으며, [Tweag]의 후원을 받았습니다

segments.source: [@lucperkins](https://github.com/lucperkins) served as the team lead from 2022-11 to 2023-01, sponsored by [Determinate Systems](https://determinate.systems)
segments.translation: [@lucperkins](https://github.com/lucperkins)는 2022-11부터 2023-01까지 팀 리더를 맡았으며, [Determinate Systems](https://determinate.systems)의 후원을 받았습니다

segments.source: [@fricklerhandwerk] served as the team lead from 2022-05 to 2022-10, sponsored by [Tweag]
segments.translation: [@fricklerhandwerk]는 2022-05부터 2022-10까지 팀 리더를 맡았으며, [Tweag]의 후원을 받았습니다

segments.source: History
segments.translation: 연혁

segments.source: Many thanks to past contributors, who helped make Nix documentation what it is today:
segments.translation: 오늘날의 Nix 문서를 만드는 데 도움을 준 과거 기여자들에게 깊이 감사드립니다:

segments.source: [@infinisil] helped lead the team between 2022-11 and 2024-05.
segments.translation: [@infinisil]는 2022-11부터 2024-05까지 팀을 이끄는 데 힘을 보탰습니다.

segments.source: During that time he provided diligent technical reviews of countless contributions, reworked the [contribution guides for Nixpkgs](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md), and rewrote his [module system tutorial](https://nix.dev/tutorials/module-system/deep-dive) for publication.
segments.translation: 그 기간 동안 그는 수많은 기여에 대해 성실하게 기술 검토를 수행했고, [Nixpkgs 기여 가이드](https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)를 개편했으며, 자신의 [모듈 시스템 튜토리얼](https://nix.dev/tutorials/module-system/deep-dive)을 게시를 위해 다시 작성했습니다.

segments.source: [@olafklingt](https://github.com/olafklingt) volunteered on the team from 2022-10 to 2024-05, and was a formal member between 2022-10 and 2024-05.
segments.translation: [@olafklingt](https://github.com/olafklingt)는 2022-10부터 2024-05까지 팀에서 자원봉사로 활동했으며, 2022-10부터 2024-05까지는 정식 구성원이었습니다.

segments.source: He added an [introduction to NixOS virtual machines](https://nix.dev/tutorials/nixos/nixos-configuration-on-vm) and greatly simplified the [tutorial on NixOS VM tests](https://nix.dev/tutorials/nixos/integration-testing-using-virtual-machines), and kept them up to date.
segments.translation: 그는 [NixOS 가상 머신 소개](https://nix.dev/tutorials/nixos/nixos-configuration-on-vm)를 추가하고 [NixOS VM 테스트 튜토리얼](https://nix.dev/tutorials/nixos/integration-testing-using-virtual-machines)을 크게 단순화했으며, 이를 계속 최신 상태로 유지했습니다.

segments.source: Both articles enjoy great popularity and are central elements of our tutorial series.
segments.translation: 두 글 모두 큰 인기를 누리고 있으며 저희 튜토리얼 시리즈의 핵심 요소입니다.

segments.source: [@brianmcgee](https://github.com/brianmcgee) was part of the team from 2023-03 to 2023-10 and contributed to the Learning Journey Working Group effort.
segments.translation: [@brianmcgee](https://github.com/brianmcgee)는 2023-03부터 2023-10까지 팀에 소속되어 학습 여정 워킹 그룹 활동에 기여했습니다.

segments.source: [@zmitchell] led the [Learning Journey Working Group](https://discourse.nixos.org/search?q=learning%20journey%20working%20group%20-%20meeting%20notes%20in%3Atitle%20order%3Alatest_topic) from 2023-03 to 2023-08 that added a number of tutorials.
segments.translation: [@zmitchell]는 2023-03부터 2023-08까지 여러 튜토리얼을 추가한 [학습 여정 워킹 그룹](https://discourse.nixos.org/search?q=learning%20journey%20working%20group%20-%20meeting%20notes%20in%3Atitle%20order%3Alatest_topic)을 이끌었습니다.

segments.source: He published [regular updates on developments in documentation](https://discourse.nixos.org/search?q=This%20Month%20in%20Nix%20Docs%20in%3Atitle%20before%3A2023-10-30%20order%3Alatest_topic) in that period.
segments.translation: 그는 그 기간 동안 [문서 개발 동향에 대한 정기 업데이트](https://discourse.nixos.org/search?q=This%20Month%20in%20Nix%20Docs%20in%3Atitle%20before%3A2023-10-30%20order%3Alatest_topic)를 게시했습니다.

segments.source: [@Mic92](https://github.com/Mic92) was a founding member and part of the team from 2022-05 to 2023-01.
segments.translation: [@Mic92](https://github.com/Mic92)는 창립 멤버로, 2022-05부터 2023-01까지 팀의 일원이었습니다.

segments.source: Jörg had written a great deal of documentation on the NixOS Wiki, and shared his experience to set a direction for the documentation team.
segments.translation: Jörg는 NixOS Wiki에 방대한 문서를 작성했으며, 자신의 경험을 공유하여 문서 팀의 방향을 설정하는 데 기여했습니다.

segments.source: [@domenkozar](https://github.com/domenkozar) was a founding member and part of the team from 2022-05 to 2023-01.
segments.translation: [@domenkozar](https://github.com/domenkozar)는 창립 멤버로, 2022-05부터 2023-01까지 팀의 일원이었습니다.

segments.source: Domen originally started nix.dev, wrote many basic tutorials, and funded editorial work through [Cachix](https://www.cachix.org/).
segments.translation: Domen은 원래 nix.dev를 시작했고, 많은 기초 튜토리얼을 작성했으며, [Cachix](https://www.cachix.org/)를 통해 편집 작업의 자금을 지원했습니다.

segments.source: He helped bootstrap the documentation team, handed out permissions, and advised us on many aspects.
segments.translation: 그는 문서 팀을 구축하는 데 도움을 주었고, 권한을 부여했으며, 여러 측면에서 저희에게 조언을 해주었습니다.

segments.source: Domen donated nix.dev to the NixOS Foundation in 2023-07.
segments.translation: Domen은 2023-07에 nix.dev를 NixOS Foundation에 기증했습니다.
